items.title: Loretta Rowland Evans Interview
items.q: But there was a Negro band called King Oliver.

ctx.x: Yeah, she played piano at 16. She danced on the stage. She was just... She was a swinger. She could dance any kind of dance. She still likes it too. She had to sing to It was close enough to ragtime, but it had in it something of the authentic jazz notes, you know? And I believe they played all through to 1920. But there was a Negro band called King Oliver. I think it was the first Negro jazz band come out. He only had eight pieces. And with or without the second cornet and trumpet, it was considered the perfect…
Did they have any, what other places did they have here besides West End that they played jazz? How about out on the camps, out on the lake? Did they have bands out there?
